description: This PHP class defines a custom exception 'NormalizeException' extending the built-in Exception class, with static methods for specific exception messages used within the normalization process of the API serializer.

classes.name: NormalizeException
classes.description: A custom exception class used in the API serializer to handle specific normalization errors.

methods.name: notSetRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that required model attributes are not set.

methods.name: unsupportedType
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that an object is of an unsupported type for normalization.
